title: Machine Learning analysis of high-grade serous ovarian cancer proteomic dataset reveals novel candidate biomarkers
summary: A feature-selection and decision-tree pipeline prioritized TOP1, PDIA4 and OGN as candidate high-grade serous ovarian cancer markers. The classifier reported 98.1% accuracy in repeated CPTAC cross-validation and 97.2% tumor sensitivity in a separate TCGA dataset; assay validation and clinical utility were not shown.
ai_technology: Machine-learning feature selection and decision-tree classification of HGSOC proteomic data
organization: Laboratori Vita; Università Campus Bio-Medico di Roma; National Research Council of Italy

evidence.tested: A three-protein classifier reported 98.1% accuracy in repeated five-fold validation and 97.2% tumor sensitivity on the separate TCGA dataset.
evidence.unknown: The authors present candidate biomarkers; no serum assay or prospective clinical utility is demonstrated.
evidence.ai_role: Feature selection and decision-tree classification prioritize protein features from high-grade serous ovarian cancer proteomic measurements.

source_review.scope: Primary full-text Methods and Results; bibliographic date and duplicate check reviewed.
